summary: Current raw OPFS composite AbortSignal remains packaged head; linked rev0194 closes the postured Web-Lock wait-contract hole by rejecting unbounded factory lock waits and unbounded per-operation timeoutMs overrides before store creation, Web Lock acquisition, or OPFS mutation unless an explicit unsafe opt-in is present. Recovery guidance, posture proof/audit, and package boundary evidence were updated; comment-only source ballast was compacted instead of widening budgets.
nonClaims: No Web Lock fairness, quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, or cross-browser proof.
Unsafe unbounded waits require explicit opt-in and are not the default postured behavior.
